import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
ax2.hist(age_data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax2.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].median():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dogs per District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.coolwarm(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Dog and Owner Gender Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_data = df.groupby(['SexHundLang', 'SexLang'])['AnzHunde'].sum().unstack()
gender_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender vs Owner Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.legend(title='Owner Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
